request: an SVG animation of a pelican riding a bike
thesis: A pelican is all bill and pouch and long legs, a bike is all circles and triangles: the joke is a bird built wrong for pedalling doing it with total commitment.
job: open the file and see a pelican on a bike at once
watch the ride loop: wheels spin, legs pedal, scenery slides, body bobs
interact: pause/play, speed control, maybe ring the bell or click the pelican
see state change on screen (speed readout, paused label)
leave it running without it drifting or stalling

principles: consistent stroke weight and round caps
tricks: transform-box: fill-box with transform-origin center for CSS rotation
stroke-dasharray on tyre for visible spin
viewBox scaling so it fits any window
tests: does a stranger say pelican on a bike at a glance
do the pedals stay attached to the feet
does it still look right after 20 seconds

principles: secondary motion: bill, pouch, feathers lag
ride speed ties wheel rotation to scenery speed
tricks: counter-rotate the pedals so they stay level
two-bone leg solved in JS each frame from crank position
scroll ground tiles by exact tile width for seamless loop

principles: requestAnimationFrame with dt, not frame counts
state in one object, UI reads it
tricks: respect prefers-reduced-motion with a gentler default
tests: buttons change state and the display

parts: pelican: huge long bill, throat pouch, small head, eye, white-grey body, wing, tail, long thin legs, webbed feet
bike: two wheels, spokes, frame, fork, handlebars, saddle, crank, chainring, pedals, chain
setting: road, sky, clouds, hills, sun
expectations: bird sits on saddle, wing or feet on handlebars

kinds.name: side view cruising
kinds.what: profile pelican riding left to right across looping countryside

descriptions: bill length about 40 percent of body
pouch sags and swings with bumps
behaviors: body bobs twice per pedal revolution

descriptions: wheel radius 40 to 55 units in a 600 wide view
behaviors: crank turns at ratio to wheel

descriptions: far layers move slower: 0.1, 0.3, 1.0 times ground speed
pause button, speed slider, bell on click of pelican
behaviors: slider changes speed live, readout shows km/h
pause freezes everything, label flips to Play

anti_keywords.instead: real wheel spin, pedal cranks and legs that follow them
solve the legs from the crank each frame

anti_keywords.not: generic cartoon bird that could be a duck
anti_keywords.instead: enormous bill with a drooping pouch

checks: pelican recognisable by the bill alone
feet stay on pedals at every angle
pause and speed visibly change state
